title: Canonical Verification Manifest
principles: Strict Parameter Invariance (Seed 42, 1024x1024, Euler/Normal, CFG 7.0, Impact Regional Backend)
No Positional Adjectives in Prompts for Spatial Oracles

spatial_verification_set.hypothesis: Region geometry alone determines character placement without positional prompting (Top-Left placement)

invariants.global_prompt: manga illustration, simple clean background, white background, high quality
invariants.global_negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, bad anatomy

spatial_verification_set.expected: White dog synthesized strictly in the top-left quadrant of the canvas; other quadrants remain clean background
spatial_verification_set.human_review_default: Verify white dog is located in the top-left area.

spatial_verification_set.hypothesis: Region geometry alone determines character placement without positional prompting (Bottom-Right placement)

invariants.global_prompt: manga illustration, simple clean background, white background, high quality
invariants.global_negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, bad anatomy

spatial_verification_set.expected: White dog synthesized strictly in the bottom-right quadrant of the canvas; top-left remains clean background
spatial_verification_set.human_review_default: Verify white dog is located in the bottom-right area, cleanly opposing Workflow 25.

spatial_verification_set.hypothesis: Two-region geometry binds distinct character semantics without spatial words in prompts (Dog Left, Cat Right)

invariants.global_prompt: manga illustration, simple clean background, white background, high quality
invariants.global_negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, bad anatomy

spatial_verification_set.expected: White dog cleanly rendered on left half; black cat cleanly rendered on right half; no chimera or identity fusion
spatial_verification_set.human_review_default: Verify dog is on left and cat is on right.

spatial_verification_set.hypothesis: Swapping region geometries cleanly swaps character positions without altering prompts or seeds (Dog Right, Cat Left)

invariants.global_prompt: manga illustration, simple clean background, white background, high quality
invariants.global_negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, bad anatomy

spatial_verification_set.expected: White dog cleanly rendered on right half; black cat cleanly rendered on left half; perfect spatial mirror of Workflow 27
spatial_verification_set.human_review_default: Verify dog is on right and cat is on left (exact inversion of Workflow 27).

canonical_authoring_set.hypothesis: Recurrent cast across 4 panels maintains character attendance, appearance, and acting separation

canonical_authoring_set.expected: Panels show designated characters with consistent appearances and distinct actions
canonical_authoring_set.human_review_default: Verify Alice and Bob appear in their assigned panels.

canonical_authoring_set.hypothesis: Same character appearing in multiple subscenes within one panel maintains identity without collapsing into a single figure or blending
canonical_authoring_set.changed_variable: Subscene spatial partition (Top vs Bottom subscenes)
canonical_authoring_set.expected: Two distinct instances of Alice rendered in different subscene regions within one panel frame
canonical_authoring_set.human_review_default: Verify two distinct Alice instances appear in their respective subscenes.
